main.description: A Prismaliser Prisma schema and graph layout snapshot.

name.description: An optional name for the shared diagram.

schema.description: The Prisma schema text used to render the diagram.

positions.description: The saved positions of the diagram's nodes.

prismaVersion.description: The Prisma version used to parse the schema.

createdAt.description: The time at which this snapshot was created.

position.description: The saved canvas position of one diagram node.

id.description: The identifier of the diagram node.

x.description: The horizontal node position in canvas coordinates.

y.description: The vertical node position in canvas coordinates.
